cards.front: What is the administrative distance of OSPF?

cards.text: The {{c1::DR}} is elected by highest {{c2::priority}}, then by highest {{c3::router ID}}.
cards.extra: A priority of 0 means the router never becomes DR or BDR.

cards.text: OSPF uses {{c1::224.0.0.5}} for all OSPF routers and {{c2::224.0.0.6}} for the DR and BDR.

cards.front: Global configuration command to start OSPF process 1?
Which LSA type describes a network segment?
cards.explanation: The DR originates the Type 2 network LSA.

cards.front: Which area must every other OSPF area connect to?
Name the OSPF neighbor states from first to last.
cards.back:
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  state "2-Way" as TwoWay
  [*] --> Down
  Down --> Init
  Init --> TwoWay
  TwoWay --> ExStart
  ExStart --> Exchange
  Exchange --> Loading
  Loading --> Full
```

Down, Init, 2-Way, ExStart, Exchange, Loading, Full.

cards.text: On a broadcast network, routers that are not the DR or BDR stay in the {{c1::2-Way}} state with each other, and reach {{c2::Full}} only with the DR and BDR.
